lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn6Cr2O8 (reduced formula Zn3CrO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2_1/c (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers in octahedral O coordination and Zn centers in both octahedral and tetrahedral O environments. These coordination polyhedra connect through corner-sharing between Cr and Zn octahedra and Zn tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Zn octahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
